row.name: Cheesecake Factory Incorporated (The) Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=19 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.3 tightness=0.93 base_volume_vs_leg=1.02 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -5.6% vs its 20-SMA, -8.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar gains only 1.52% — well below the 4% minimum Bonde requires for a range-expansion day — and volume came in at 0.82x the prior session and 0.72x the 50-day average, meaning there is no volume confirmation at all. The consolidation box sits inside a visible multi-week decline from the August peak near 118, so the base is not a tight pause after an advance but a lower-high, lower-low structure with wide overlapping bars drifting downward. This would be breakout attempt four of the same move, and the chart shows the prior three pushes above 110 all failed and reversed.
claude.key_risk: The base is a downtrend, not a consolidation — each rally inside the box has been sold, and there is no evidence of absorption.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of open price; the burst bar itself does not meet the 4% gain threshold and volume is below the prior session, so no open condition rescues this setup.

row.summary: CAKE: +1.5% out of a base 15.3% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
